title: cyanthillium cinereum
intro: Cyanthillium cinereum, commonly known as African fireweed or fire bush, is a flowering plant native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Cyanthillium cinereum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
